text: A股房地产板块短线拉升，城投控股涨停，福星股份此前封板，特发服务、信达地产、市北高新、华发股份、上实发展等跟涨。
text_en: A-share real estate sector surged in intraday trading, with Chengdu Investment Holding hitting the daily limit, Fuxing shares previously sealed at the limit, and Tefa Services, Cinda Real Estate, Shibei High-Tech, Huafa Industrial and Shanghai Industrial Development following suit.
